title: Grilled Italian Chicken Skewers
description: A classic Italian dish featuring marinated chicken breast, grilled to perfection on skewers. Great as a main course or appetizer.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and Peruvian pepper.
2. Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
7. While the skewers are grilling, mix the crunchy bread crumbs and nutty Parmesan in a small bowl.
8. Once the skewers are cooked, brush them with the bread crumb mixture and serve hot.
